tatkal_timings.ac_classes: 10:00 AM IST on the day prior to train departure
tatkal_timings.non_ac_classes: 11:00 AM IST on the day prior to train departure

booking_rules.children_rule: Children under 5 years travel free without a berth. Children aged 5 to 11 pay full fare if a berth is allocated, or half fare without a separate berth.

more_than_48_hours_before_departure.description: Flat cancellation charge per passenger deducted

between_48_and_12_hours_before_departure.description: 25% of total fare deducted, subject to minimum flat charge

between_12_and_4_hours_before_departure.description: 50% of total fare deducted, subject to minimum flat charge

less_than_4_hours_or_after_chart_prep.description: No refund admissible once chart is prepared or less than 4 hours remain before scheduled departure

tatkal_tickets.description: Confirmed Tatkal tickets are non-refundable under standard cancellation.

waitlisted_rac_tickets.description: Waitlisted or RAC tickets cancelled up to 30 minutes before departure are refunded with flat clerkage fee of ₹60 per passenger.

quota_rules.name: General Quota
quota_rules.description: Open to all passengers booking advance tickets up to 120 days.

quota_rules.name: Tatkal Quota
quota_rules.description: Premium emergency quota opening 1 day prior to journey date.

quota_rules.name: Ladies Quota
quota_rules.description: Reserved for solo female travelers or women traveling with children under 12.

quota_rules.name: Senior Citizen Quota
quota_rules.description: Lower berth preference for male citizens aged 60+ and female citizens aged 45+ traveling solo.

prohibited_items: Inflammable substances, gas cylinders, fireworks, dangerous weapons
security_and_conduct_policy.alcohol_and_smoking: Strictly prohibited inside coaches and station premises. Offense carries fine and prosecution under Railway Act Section 145.
